name: glslCanvas
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Legacy fragment-shader canvas host; superseded by OGL or regl
summary: Tiny library that mounts a GLSL fragment shader on a canvas via a data attribute, feeding u_time, u_resolution and u_mouse. Its clock is wall time, so capture needs the time uniform overridden to be deterministic. Unmaintained since 2022.
use_when: Quick fragment-shader prototype from a book-of-shaders style snippet
avoid_when: Deterministic frames: OGL, regl or twgl with t as an explicit uniform
Shader module reuse: glslify with any of those
Headless Node shaders: CanvasKit SkSL, no browser

assessment.rationale: No release since Nov 2022 and repo idle since mid 2023; WebGL1-era. Fragment-shader hosting is covered by OGL, regl and twgl, which are maintained and give explicit control of the time uniform.
